name: ArXivMath
subtitle: 回答近期研究中的数学问题

officialDefinition.summary: 从近期 arXiv 论文摘要构造研究级数学题，要求模型给出可验证的最终答案。
officialDefinition.task: 回答由近期arXiv数学论文核心结果构造的自包含研究问题，以最终答案核验正确性。

taskContract.input: 数学题面，通常采用LaTeX；不给答题模型原论文或摘要。
taskContract.environment: 解析或抽取最终答案并与gold answer比较；官方说明论文检索实验未纳入主榜方法。

dataProfile.summary: 2026-06问题、标准答案与论文来源公开，月份对应不同题集。
splits: Hugging Face以train标签存放48条评测记录。
files: arxivmath-0626 的 HF data/ Parquet 发布 48 条 train 记录，含题目、gold answer 和 source/title/authors；README_arxivmath.md 描述构题筛选。

requirements: 可直接访问Hugging Face数据集；复现需固定月份和答案解析流程。

reusePolicy.license: arxivmath-0626数据卡声明CC BY-SA 4.0；工具代码和底层资源许可分别适用。
reusePolicy.scope: 本站仅展示固定来源快照中经核验的精选任务字段，保留出处与适用许可；不将其许可外推至外部网页、模型输出或未采用媒体。
boundaries: 数据卡许可适用于所列月份数据；引用时应遵守署名和相同方式共享等条件。
不得把数据卡许可自动扩展至工具代码或其他第三方资源。

sampleAccess.reason: 5 条真实案例可在本站切换查看，原字段及数据入口保留。每条解析说明具体任务和取样范围；公开示例不代替完整题集。

metric.name: 最终答案准确率
metric.description: 模型最终答案与数据集gold answer核对；数据按月更新，比较成绩需固定同一月份和运行配置。

limitations.text: 官方抽样检查中约30%问题可能依据论文引用的既有研究回答。
构造依赖原论文结果正确，而arXiv论文未必经过同行评审。

本轮核对官方公开材料，未实际运行评测或复核某个模型的成绩。

samples.title: 禁止特定子图后的极值计数
samples.prompt: Let $ex(n, K_{t,t}, K_{2,t+1})$ denote the maximum number of copies of the complete bipartite graph $K_{t,t}$ that an $n$-vertex $K_{2,t+1}$-free graph can contain. For a fixed prime power $t \geq 3$, evaluate the limit $\lim_{e \to \infty} \frac{ex(n_e, K_{t, t}, K_{2, t+1})}{n_e^2}$, where $n_e = t^{2e - 1}$.
samples.explanation: 这道研究数学题要求给出极值计数的精确极限；参考答案直接取自同一固定数据记录，没有补写解题过程。

raw.title: $K_{2, t+1}$-free graphs containing an optimal number of $K_{t, t}$'s

samples.title: A Domatic Analogue of $χ$-Bounded Graph Classes and the Gyárfás-Sumner Conjecture · problem 2
samples.prompt: The domatic number of a graph $G$, denoted ${\rm dom}(G)$, is the maximum size of a partition of $V(G)$ into dominating sets. It has been proven that for any $P_4$-free graph (cograph) $G$ with minimum degree $\delta$, the domatic number satisfies the lower bound ${\rm dom}(G) \ge a\delta + b$, where $a$ and $b$ are real constants. Given that the expression $a\delta + b$ is the best possible linear lower bound in terms of $\delta$, what is the ordered pair $(a, b)$?
samples.explanation: 给定 cograph 的最小度，题目要求最佳线性下界中的两个系数，而不是只报一个界。官方 answer 是有序对(1/2, 1)，原题和论文归属信息保留。

samples.title: Token-sliding realizability for complements, Cartesian-products, and grid graph families · problem 4
samples.prompt: For an integer $k \ge 0$ and a graph $G$, the token-sliding reconfiguration graph $\mathsf{TS}_k(G)$ has the independent $k$-sets of $G$ as vertices. Two vertices are adjacent if one token can slide along an edge of $G$ and the resulting $k$-set is still independent. A graph $H$ is said to be $\mathsf{TS}_k$-realizable if there exists a graph $G$ such that $H$ is isomorphic to $\mathsf{TS}_k(G)$. What is the minimum integer $k \ge 2$ such that the grid graph $P_3 \square P_3$ (the Cartesian product of two paths on 3 vertices) is $\mathsf{TS}_k$-realizable?
samples.explanation: 问题先定义 token-sliding 重配置图，再问3×3网格可实现时的最小 token 数。原答案为4，本站没有把该数值扩写成来源未提供的构造证明。

samples.prompt: In the theory of knotted surfaces in $S^4$, the tri-plane crossing number is defined as the minimal number of crossings in a tri-plane diagram for a bridge trisection of the surface. What is the exact value of the tri-plane crossing number of the 2-twist spun trefoil?

samples.title: Stacking and Clearing in Directed Graph Pebbling · problem 6
samples.prompt: Suppose that pebbles are distributed on the vertices of a directed graph $D$. A directed pebbling step $u \to v$ along an arc $u \to v$ removes two pebbles from $u$ and places one pebble on $v$. The stacking number $\text{stack}(D)$ is the least integer $t \ge 2$ such that every configuration with $t$ pebbles can be transformed by a finite sequence of pebbling steps into a configuration with all remaining pebbles on a single vertex. Let $C_n$ be the directed $n$-cycle. For $n \ge 2$, what is the exact formula for $\text{stack}(C_n)$ as a function of $n$?
samples.explanation: 有向 pebbling 每步消耗两个卵石、在后继处产生一个，问题要求有向环的 stacking number 闭式。官方公式 answer 原样保留；本站不把无向图的结论套进这道题。
